parameters.content:
## LIA · Intake
Webhook `POST /webhook/leads` (HMAC-signed), or the internal trigger (LIA · Form, replays) → signature, rate limit, spam and duplicate checks → **202 in milliseconds** → LLM qualification (primary, fallback) → output gate → HubSpot contact + note (+ deal for hot/warm) → hot: instant reply, warm: follow-ups, cold or review: log → Telegram to the owner.
Every external call retries 3×; any failure goes to **LIA · Errors** (dead letter + alert).

nodes.name: Note · LLM with fallback, then an output gate

parameters.content:
### LLM with fallback, then an output gate
Lead text goes in as quoted data, never as instructions. A pre-filter flags injection attempts; the gate refuses automation when the answer is broken or tries something it may not (other addresses, links off the allowlist, prices). Those leads are *held for review*, never auto-emailed.

### Email safety rule
Only addresses matching `real_inbox_regex` are really emailed. Everything else is written to `lia_outbox` only.
